body:
There's another big deviation between $SPX and $QQQ this morning. The Nasdaq-$QQQ is down 5.5 points while $SPX is almost flat. We're seeing more weaknesses in Al/Memory stocks while $AAPL, $GOOGL, $MSFT, and $GS are higher. There's a clear rotation for now, so be careful buying the dip on Chip/Al/Memory until we see a bottom actually form.
CPI data is coming out premarket tmrw. This will help determine if we get another rate hike at the end of the month, so most likely we'll see another consolidation day today.
$MSFT to 550 is in play, $AAPL to 350 can come as well. $META 750 has been a tough level to break out above; let's see if it can get through this week
The only way $QQQ looks better is if it moves from red to green today and reclaims 748 by Friday.
Don't overtrade today. The real move comes by Thursday. Good luck everyone!!🫡
